collection.description: Adults disagree about whether the village needs stricter schedules or more freedom to work at their own pace.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Adults disagree about whether the village needs stricter schedules or more freedom to work at their own pace.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Essential duties are covered while villagers choose their preferred hours.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An important handoff is missed, revealing the need for one fixed meeting time.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The group retains safety rules and relaxes several customs.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They discover that one unpopular rule protects children near the water.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager), a night-oriented worker, explains why dawn assignments are difficult.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) describes why unpredictable shifts create childcare problems.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A week of structured shifts improves coordination.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A week of looser shifts improves morale but requires clearer accountability.
